## Design

### 2026-10-06 – I downloaded, set up, and used KiCAD for the first time today. I've never really gotten into PCB design so this is a total first for me. I had some frustration trying to figure out the keybinds, but t

**4h**

I downloaded, set up, and used KiCAD for the first time today. I've never really gotten into PCB design so this is a total first for me. I had some frustration trying to figure out the keybinds, but the mouse controls are similar to Fusion, so that helped.

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 213134](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/4a1a6f0cabff1cd619acb5cda690a98f6a1d22025426e0c960d18c45a731ba96.png)
My first PCB schematic!

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 213255](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/d61110d21227fc5d484ae21350e27d2e3c85b7fc3732216aeb3ee4749b56feb9.png)
After doing my first schematic, I tried to go to the next step but I just couldn't figure it out for a while, so I took a break. (I didn't know how assigning the footprints worked so it was a simple fix).

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 220407](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/cca07eecc277861e720c3293dd25c2c64530aa51561ba8234625c1fd0b3e10df.png)
I finally got everything in position to do my PCB, but, even with the help of YouTube, couldn't figure out how to get the ground plane to work.

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 222959](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/0CkUxdN5HZgh0MbVudWobYQ7CUJYEUjI/f57921147ec903d8efbb8efa871a702486fe6f98e13b556afee442d9a7dbc837.png)
Finally, after a ton of trial and error I got the ground plane to work.
